face_paint_512_v2.onnx: AnimeGANv2 "Face Portrait v2" generator weights by Bryan Lee
(https://github.com/bryandlee/animegan2-pytorch, MIT License, see LICENSE), ONNX export from
https://huggingface.co/akhaliq/AnimeGANv2-ONNX (face_paint_512_v2_0.onnx, sha256 1381b17e...a63e).
Input/output: float32 [1,3,512,512], RGB in [-1, 1]. Used only by the hidden test page /me/dogs/<id>/pixel-ai,
run on the visitor's device with ONNX Runtime Web (MIT, loaded from jsDelivr).
